## Engineering Work & Shipped Systems

- **Full-Stack Web Development & Client Systems (2024 – Present)**
  - Builds and deploys custom websites, clinic and healthcare web platforms with mobile-optimized inquiry/appointment flows, and responsive business systems using React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Laravel, CodeIgniter, MySQL, and WebSockets.
  - Case Studies: https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/projects

- **Co-Founder & Technical Lead · Team SHIFT (2024 – Present · Dumaguete City)**
  - Co-founded Students Harnessing Interest for Technology (SHIFT), leading student developers across software engineering, systems administration, and cybersecurity.
  - Built internal university systems, student administrative platforms, and FRACS (Facial Recognition Attendance Checker Platform).
  - University Feature (FU CCS Facebook): https://www.facebook.com/share/p/18fJmyJseu/
  - Supported with evidence at: https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/gallery#hackforgov and https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/gallery#hackit

- **Lead AI Systems Architect & Embedded Hardware Engineer · OvaLens Ecosystem (2026 – 2027 · Dumaguete City)**
  - Undergraduate Capstone project: autonomous duck-egg candling and fertility sorting machine.
  - Custom YOLOv8 computer vision model trained on a curated candling dataset, hyperparameter-tuned, and quantized via ONNX for edge inference on a low-compute Raspberry Pi.
  - Interfaced ESP32 microcontrollers, NEMA stepper motor drivers, and servo diversion gates for real-time mechanical sorting, backed by an offline-sync web engine.
  - Deep-Dive Case Study: https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/projects/ovalens
  - Model Repository: https://github.com/Dev-RyleR6/OvaLens-Ecosystem
